The selected candidate will work the overnight shift, monitoring network alerts, receiving technical support requests from 911 communications centers, documenting incidents, coordinating with technology vendors, and escalating service disruptions. This position emphasizes network monitoring, technical support, incident management, customer service, and operational coordination , rather than hands-on network configuration or administration. The client intends to consider the selected contractor for a permanent state position following the initial assignment, subject to satisfactory performance and applicable hiring requirements. Technical Support & Incident Management Respond to technical support requests from Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs) across North Carolina. Gather information regarding equipment failures, connectivity issues, call-processing problems, and service interruptions. Create, update, and close incident records using Salesforce case management tools. Document incident timelines, troubleshooting activities, vendor responses, and resolutions. Assign incident priorities based on severity and operational impact. Escalate unresolved or critical issues to Tier II support, vendors, or management. Participate in technical conference calls and incident response bridges. Maintain communication between 911 centers and technical support personnel. Customer Service & Documentation Provide courteous, professional, and timely support to emergency communications personnel. Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Maintain accurate incident records and operational logs. Prepare detailed shift handover notes. Remain calm and organized during high-priority incidents. Support continuous improvement of incident management procedures. Strong computer, communication, documentation, and customer service skills. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced operational environment. Dependable attendance and willingness to work overnight shifts, including assigned weekends and holidays. Experience using Salesforce or similar incident management platforms. Familiarity with network monitoring, incident response, and escalation procedures. Coordinating incident management across teams and conducting post-incident review, driving severity classification and tracking the resulting actions to closure. review_candidates.title: Technology Solution Manager - Global Payroll Operate
review_candidates.description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is the hub of innovation, a technology powerhouse, a global talent center and, a driver of operational excellence within EY, propelling EY’s purpose of building a better working world. With a robust network spread across 9 countries and 20 cities, GDS’s dynamic network of highly talented professionals leverage data, AI, and cutting-edge technology to enhance EY's wide array of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Join us at EY GDS Hungary to shape your future with confidence. Position Overview The EY GPO Client Solution Manager is a client-facing lead role within EY Global Payroll Operate responsible for shaping, designing, and delivering global payroll technology and implementation solutions for multinational clients. The role bridges client stakeholders, EY technology, implementation, central, service management, and payroll teams to ensure global payroll solutions are scalable, compliant, integrated, and aligned to client business objectives. Purpose of the Role This Manager leads solutioning from sales handover through implementation and go-live, setting the global design approach, guiding client decisions, managing expectations, and enabling consistent local delivery across countries. The role serves as a subject matter expert for EY’s GPO technology ecosystem, including EY Payroll Command Center, EY Digital Payroll, EY Interact Payroll, EY IP Mobile, GTPW, in-country payroll, and integrations with client HCM, workforce management, general ledger, and third-party systems. Key Responsibilities Lead global design workshops and client solutioning sessions to define requirements, solution architecture, integration scope, data flows, testing approach, conversion strategy, cutover planning, and go-live readiness. Own and maintain global implementation deliverables, including global user stories, solution design documents, integration designs, SOR global mapping data dictionaries, testing plans, conversion plans, and deployment strategies. Act as the global design owner, monitoring local design decisions for impact on the overall solution and redirecting or re-solutioning where needed to preserve scalability, quality, compliance, and maintainability. Support sales-to-implementation handover activities, including review and clarification of MSA, SOW, LCA, PSM, scope assumptions, pricing inputs, and implementation commitments. Serve as the primary technology and solution point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders, articulating EY’s payroll technology capabilities and advising on implementation options, risks, and trade-offs. Lead cross-functional implementation teams across multiple countries or regions, managing scope, timelines, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, budgets, and project communications. Collaborate with EY technology, central, service management, payroll, and local implementation teams to ensure delivery aligns with EY global standards, quality requirements, client expectations, and project governance. Provide escalation support, issue resolution, quality assurance, and solution guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle. Support business development activities such as RFPs, RFIs, pricing, client pitches, technology demonstrations, feasibility assessments, and vendor evaluations. Contribute to continuous improvement by developing templates, tools, methodologies, lessons learned, and action plans that enhance EY GPO implementation capability and client value. Coach and mentor team members, support professional development, and foster a collaborative, high-performing delivery culture. Required Experience And Skills 6+ years of experience in global payroll implementations, HR/payroll technology, systems integration, program management, or technology consulting within complex multinational environments. Proven ability to lead large-scale, multi-country payroll or HCM implementations through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Strong understanding of payroll business processes, global payroll operations, regulatory compliance, data privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border payroll data requirements. Experience with cloud-based global payroll or HR platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, ADP, or similar systems, including inbound and outbound integrations. Hands-on understanding of integration technologies and data formats, including APIs, middleware, ETL, EDI, SFTP, XML, JSON, CSV, data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation. Strong project and program management capability, including scope, budget, resource, timeline, risk, issue, dependency, financial, and stakeholder management. Excellent communication, executive presence, facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated leadership in matrixed environments, including the ability to influence teams, resolve ambiguity, drive accountability, and deliver high-quality outcomes under tight deadlines. Financial acumen, including experience with project budgets, billing, margins, ERP reporting, service specifications, and Statements of Work. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, MIS, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 preferred. Lean Six Sigma experience or certification preferred. Global payroll implementation experience or certification preferred. Workday, Oracle, SAP, or integration-related certification preferred. SAP US payroll implementation experience and background is an added value and preferred qualification. Experience with EY technology platforms, GPO service delivery models, or managed payroll services preferred. Fluency in English required; Spanish, German, French, or Portuguese language capability is an added value. Key Success Factors Builds trusted advisor relationships with clients and internal stakeholders globally. Balances strategic solution design with pragmatic implementation delivery. Anticipates risks, identifies integration challenges early, and drives scalable, serviceable solutions. Maintains strong focus on quality, compliance, operational excellence, automation, and client experience. Develops people, strengthens delivery capability, and contributes to continuous improvement across EY GPO. EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

review_candidates.title: Operations and IT Coordinator
review_candidates.location: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
review_candidates.description: You're the person colleagues come to when something in Microsoft 365 isn't working, and you fix it properly. You like building the workflow that means nobody has to do that job by hand again. You'd run the systems behind iO-Sphere and The AI Board from Cape Town, working directly with our Operations Manager. What you'd do iO-Sphere trains people in data and AI, and The AI Board awards qualifications in them. Both are UK organisations, and both run on Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, HubSpot and Zapier. It's one role across both organisations, with shared systems and priorities, so it isn't double the work. We want someone who gets hands-on with a problem and sorts it, rather than flagging it and waiting for someone else to fix it. Your week Building workflows and automations in HubSpot, Microsoft 365, Teams and Zapier, and spotting the next job worth automating. Running our platforms day to day, which means users, licences and email, joiners and leavers, software subscriptions and the device register. Looking after SharePoint, including the structure and templates behind the applications and evidence that centres submit to The AI Board. Being the first point of contact for IT, helping people with their problems and getting them more out of the tools they use. Setting up and managing company laptops through our device management system. Keeping both organisations ready for Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001, from the policies and security basics to the incident and data request logs, the data protection register, and helping prepare the yearly certification applications. Keeping the pages, course and qualification details and forms on The AI Board's website accurate and working, and later on iO-Sphere's too. Making sure policies, processes and other key documents are stored where people can find them, kept up to date and version-controlled. We're a startup, so there'll be other things to pick up as we grow, and we'd expect you to help where it's needed. Why you'd want it You'd own the systems two organisations run on, and you'd see the time your automations save people. You'd get good at HubSpot, Microsoft 365 administration and security compliance. How we work isn't finished. If you see a better way to do something, we'll actually do it. Who you are You've done hands-on Microsoft 365 administration, with users, licences, email, Teams and SharePoint, and that one's essential. You've built workflows or automations in a CRM. HubSpot is ideal, but Salesforce, Zoho or something similar is fine. You work through everyday IT problems logically. You notice when something's inefficient and can say why a fix is worth making. You teach yourself new tools from the documentation, a course or an AI tool, and you understand what you build well enough to explain how it works. You keep records, access and documents straight. It helps if you've used Zapier or something like it, edited a website in HubSpot CMS or WordPress, know UK GDPR or POPIA, or hold a HubSpot or Microsoft certification. You don't need to know Cyber Essentials or ISO 27001 yet, as long as you're willing to learn what they ask for. You'll need clear written and spoken English, you'll need to be comfortable working remotely, and you'll need to live in or near Cape Town so you can come into our office in Riverlands. If that's you, we want to hear from you. The details Full-time, on a contractor agreement. You'd work 9:00 to 17:30 SAST and get 20 days' paid leave plus South African public holidays, the same as our employed staff. We don't have a South African company, so this isn't PAYE. Nothing is deducted and you pay your own tax as a provisional taxpayer. Cape Town hybrid (Riverlands office). Mainly remote, with office days in Riverlands for training and team working, so you need to live in or near Cape Town. R24,000 to R28,500 a month (cost to company, before tax), depending on experience. Start: Early 2027. The right to work in South Africa (we can't offer visa sponsorship). Two references, one from your most recent employer. A SAPS police clearance certificate with digital fingerprints, apostilled, which we arrange and pay for. A criminal record doesn't automatically stop you being considered. Safeguarding and Prevent training, which we give you when you join. Apply on our website through the Apply button. You'll see the full job description, how we hire, and the form. About iO-Sphere and The AI Board We train people in data and AI by having them do the work. Over 1,000 people have trained with us, and companies including PwC, BAE Systems and Dunelm send their teams to us. The AI Board is the UK's only awarding body built just for artificial intelligence and data. It's based in Norwich and offers Ofqual-regulated qualifications to learners, education centres and employers.

review_candidates.description: Ben jij degene die altijd overzicht houdt, zaken graag organiseert én energie krijgt van contact met collega's? Bij Flexim zoeken we een Business Assistant die ervoor zorgt dat onze organisatie soepel draait. Je bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor zo'n 100 collega's, ondersteunt verschillende afdelingen en speelt een actieve rol in het verbeteren van processen, organiseren van evenementen en creëren van een prettige werkomgeving. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag organiseer je een kennissessie of ondersteun je recruitment, de andere dag optimaliseer je een proces, regel je zaken rondom het wagenpark of zorg je dat collega's direct geholpen worden. Dankzij jouw initiatief, overzicht en organisatietalent maak je dagelijks zichtbaar verschil binnen de organisatie. Wat ga je doen? Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor collega's, leveranciers en externe relaties. Je ondersteunt HR, Recruitment, Finance, Marketing, Backoffice en Wagenparkbeheer. Je organiseert interne evenementen, kennissessies en medewerkersinitiatieven. Je signaleert verbeterkansen en helpt processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten. Je beheert en optimaliseert administratieve processen, documentatie en SharePoint. Je draagt bij aan een professionele, gastvrije en goed georganiseerde kantooromgeving. Wat breng jij mee? MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring in een ondersteunende, coördinerende of organisatorische functie. Een proactieve, zelfstandige en servicegerichte instelling. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatietalent. Je ziet werk liggen, denkt mee en houdt overzicht. Affiniteit met Microsoft 365, Teams en SharePoint. Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Bij Flexim krijg je geen standaard ondersteunende functie, maar een veelzijdige spilfunctie waarin je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en écht impact hebt op de organisatie. Wij Bieden Een afwisselende functie waarin geen dag hetzelfde is. Een centrale rol met veel contact binnen de organisatie. Ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ideeën en verbeteringen. Flexibel en plaats-onafhankelijk werken. Volop mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en ontwikkeling. Een hecht en betrokken team met leuke activiteiten, bijeenkomsten en uitjes. Een salaris tussen € 2.750,- en € 3.000,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis). 8% vakantiegeld. Uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Waarom werken bij Flexim? Flexim is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat jouw ideeën welkom zijn en dat je direct invloed hebt op hoe we samenwerken, processen verbeteren en collega's ondersteunen.
